name: Facet
text: We should prioritize a dark theme for our interface because it provides better visibility and clarity, especially for data visualization, as seen in successful examples like Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard. This decision will also enhance the overall liveliness and enjoyment of our screen. By choosing a dark theme, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially higher development time to ensure sufficient contrast and readability, but it's worth it for the improved user experience. This theme will also complement the live contrast checker we plan to implement, which will flag any severe contrast issues after design changes.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes improve visibility for data visualization, but they risk training users to ignore warnings—like the live contrast checker we already have. A better alternative is a toggle: let users switch between dark and light themes based on their task needs. Settle it with a quick user test: measure how often warnings are missed in each theme.
